sarah: Quick follow-up from the RFC — if the edge proxy fails over a streaming request to a slower fallback model midstream, who owns the stream state and how do we surface that in telemetry?
kevin: Short answer: there isn't a single owner today. Edge keeps conn state, backend keeps kvcache. Failover can leave ambiguous partials.
anita: We should attach a handoff header like `x-rw-handoff-id` and emit a structured event when we switch backends. That gives us traceability without coupling runtime state machines.
matt: +1 on handoff-id. Also capture `handoff_reason` (capacity|timeout|model-error) and `handoff_latency_ms`. Those will help PSO and SRE triage regressions.
sarah: Good. Tradeoffs? I'm worried about memory/latency if we buffer to preserve exact token-level continuity during handoff.
kevin: Right — preserving exact token continuity requires buffering the last N tokens and K/V window; cost grows with seq len. Option A: buffer fixed small window (e.g., 512 tokens) and accept approximate continuity. Option B: eager checkpoint every chunk -> higher overhead.
anita: We can do opportunistic checkpointing: sample heavy sessions and record full kvcache for those, otherwise emit only handoff metadata. That keeps cost down and still gives us repro for some failures.
matt: For observability, add a span annotation when handoff occurs and a tag `rw.handoff=true`. Grafana can then break down p50/p95 for handoff vs non-handoff. Also increment counter `edge.handoffs_total{reason=...}`.
sarah: How about client-visible behavior? Should clients see a short restart chunk or transparent resume?
kevin: Ideally transparent resume. Practically we need to consider idempotency and duplicate token emission. Two approaches: idempotent-resume where we dedupe by token-checkpoint, or restart-and-tag where we emit `[[RESUMED]]` trailer so callers can detect duplication.
anita: I prefer restart-and-tag for now — simpler and explicit. Add a small header `x-rw-resume-mode: tag` and include trailer `--RESUMED--` in stream. We can iterate later.
matt: Also record a metric for duplicated-token-rate so we know if tag-mode is too noisy.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: edge-proxy/handoff-idging v2 -> canary at 2024-07-12T03:00Z :rocket:
sarah: Plan for rollout: implement `x-rw-handoff-id`, emit handoff events, add tracing tags, enable tag-resume mode behind a feature flag. Start canary on 1% traffic.
kevin: I'll sketch the proxy change: add handoff manager module, attach id, capture minimal snapshot (last 256 tokens), emit event to eventlog. Backend adapters will read `x-rw-handoff-id` and attempt resume.
anita: I'll add observability docs and dashboard template. Also create alert: if `edge.handoffs_total / edge.requests_total > 0.5%` for 5m, page SRE.
matt: Need tests: simulated midstream model kill and assert `--RESUMED--` appears once and latency delta logged.
sarah: OK, action items: @kevin impl PR for handoff manager, @anita dashboards + alert, @matt e2e test harness, I'll own rollout plan and canary.
kevin: will do, PR by EOD Wednesday.
anita: starting dashboard draft now.
matt: I'll add unit and integration tests.
sarah: Thanks team. Leaving this thread open for follow-ups, but this is the direction. :thumbsup:
